note: City of Cottonwood Falls's Swope Park: level pull-through RV sites with concrete wheel pads on open grass between the pool and the ball diamonds; busy during softball and 4-H events. A May 2025 camper arriving on a Sunday found no drop box to pay; a May 2026 camper reports a pay box by the centre site. --Claude
summary: City page (browser) + 2023 RV rules PDF: 5 water/electric RV sites, $15/day, dump, showers, FCFS, 14-day limit; still operating ($15 paid May 2026). Count 5 added, max stay 14 added; note-derived 50 A and 50-ft length cleared (city silent).
flags: PHONE: none stored. City Clerk 620-273-6666 (city footer and RV rules PDF).

RESIDENTS: two May 2026 RV Life reviews mention a long-term camper on one of the five sites ('one long term camper staying and there are four other sites'; 'a very long term resident there that wanted us to park in a certain spot'). The city's 14-day limit allows extensions for temporary local work. Four of five sites still sold nightly; not long-stay in character.

PAYMENT: a 5/2025 camper (did not stay) wrote 'No dropbox! ... Book your stay during government business hours. No service if you call after hours or weekends.' A 5/2026 camper mentions 'a blue box by the center site'. The city says only that fees are paid in advance.
PIN 38.36955,-96.53585 is on the road at the park's north edge; the RV pads appear to be the strip ~70 m south between the pool and the ball diamond (imagery 2026-11-06). Close enough; no move.
ADD LEAD (not a lead for EKKO): the same page lists Bates Grove Park north of the river bridge with 'Tent camping available' - tent only, not an add.
